limitations: Purposive sample; chronology is reporting, not unseen validation.
At most four regime clusters, exact K^K resampling is descriptive, with overlapping horizons.
No horizon pooling or cross-intersection model league table.
All market forecasts abstain; nominal/real/breakeven drifts are descriptive only.
Policy anchors include known decided changes even before next-day implementation.
C0 is eligible only where public anchor reconstructed; C1 isolates conventional-floor assumption.
metric_dependence: With fixed modal p and equal other probabilities, accuracy, Brier and NLL are algebraically linked; sensitivity0.4/0.6/0.8 is design sensitivity, not independent skill validation.
